title: Wire a backend app into the workspace: shared-types, scope tags, module-boundary constraints

backend.description: Which backend the api app uses. App creation itself is delegated to the official @nx generator — when the api project is missing, the refusal report prints the exact commands to run first

apiName.description: Name of the backend application project to wire (convention: api)

frontendProject.description: Explicit frontend project to wire, skipping auto-detection — the escape hatch when the workspace has several applications

applyEslint.description: Write the scope depConstraints into the root ESLint config (only the exact Nx-generated allow-all block is rewritten; anything else degrades to a report-only snippet). Off by default so existing configs are never modified unasked

dryRun.description: Preview every wiring action with zero writes
